districtFact: Cincinnati Public Schools publishes a true 12-month calendar: the regular student year ends in May, Summer School is identified for June, and district operating holidays continue into July. Its color key also separates dates when only schools close from dates when all of CPS, including the central office, closes.
profileDisclaimer: Enrollment is approximate and comes from the current CPS district profile. School assignments, program calendars, and district dates may change.

about.title: The CPS Calendar Tracks Two Kinds of Closure
about.content: Orange dates close schools while some central-office operations may continue; green dates close all of CPS. That distinction matters for employees and families contacting the district, even though both colors normally mean no classes for students.

about.title: This Is a 12-Month Operations Calendar
about.content: The PDF runs from August through July, not merely from the first to the last student day. It identifies Summer School as June 1–30 and continues to show Juneteenth and Independence Day operations after the regular school year ends.

about.title: Midterm Weeks and Quarter Endings Are Built In
about.content: CPS places midterm-week markers and four quarter endings directly on the district calendar. They are academic planning markers, not automatic student closures, so families should pair them with school-level grading and conference information.

about.title: The 2026–27 Calendar Has a Furlough Revision
about.content: The English PDF updated July 16, 2026 adds five CFT/CAAS furlough days, reduces the student total to 170, and moves the student last day to May 25. Spanish, French, and Arabic PDFs created in March still show the earlier 171-day schedule and May 26 ending, so the current English PDF controls the dates on this site.

about.title: CPS Publishes Calendars in Four Languages
about.content: The calendar hub offers English, Spanish, French, and Arabic editions for 2026–27 and 2027–28. Translation files are linked as official family resources, but their creation dates and labels are checked separately rather than assumed to match every later English revision.

about.title: Cincinnati Combines Neighborhood and Magnet Choice
about.content: Neighborhood elementary assignments follow a home address, while magnet and high schools are not tied to that address in the same way. CPS lists Montessori, arts, world-language, STEM, gifted, online, and other options, so the district calendar is the baseline rather than a substitute for a selected school's own events.

calendarNotes: The CPS 12-month calendar is the districtwide planning baseline for regular student attendance. A school-only closure still means students do not attend, but the central office may remain open; an all-CPS closure shuts schools and the central office. Midterm weeks and quarter endings are academic markers, not days off unless another label says so. Teacher classroom workdays, professional-development days, and CFT/CAAS furlough days are no-student dates when they fall inside the student year. Teacher Conference Exchange Days sit inside school-only breaks rather than creating an additional student closure. Summer School runs separately in June and should not be treated as an extension of the regular 170- or 171-day calendar. For 2026–27, use the English PDF updated July 16, 2026 because the translated PDFs still reflect the earlier schedule. Families should confirm building events, magnet deadlines, transportation, athletics, testing, and emergency revisions with CPS and the student's school.

planningTips.title: Planning with Cincinnati CPS's 12-Month Calendar
content: Use the student first and last days for the regular school year; June Summer School and later district holidays do not extend every student's attendance calendar.
Treat both 'Only Schools Closed' and 'All of CPS Is Closed' as no-class dates, but check the label before assuming the central office is unavailable.
Do not count midterm weeks or quarter endings as closures unless the same date is also marked as a no-student day.
Keep the February Teacher Conference Exchange Day on childcare plans because schools are closed even though it is not part of a multiweek recess.
For 2026–27, compare any translated calendar with the English PDF updated July 16, 2026; the translated files still show the pre-furlough last day.
Neighborhood elementary families should verify the address assignment, while magnet and high-school families should retain school-selection and school-level calendars.
A downloaded ICS file is a one-time copy. Recheck the CPS calendar page after a schedule revision or emergency closure.

districtFaqs.q: Is this CPS calendar for Cincinnati or Chicago?
districtFaqs.a: This page covers Cincinnati Public Schools in Ohio. Chicago Public Schools also uses the abbreviation CPS but publishes a different calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Does 'Only Schools Closed' mean Cincinnati CPS students attend?
districtFaqs.a: No. Students do not attend when the calendar says only schools are closed. The wording distinguishes school operations from dates when the central office also closes.

districtFaqs.q: Are CPS midterm weeks no-school weeks?
districtFaqs.a: No. A midterm-week marker identifies an academic checkpoint, not a break. Students attend unless a separate closure or no-student label appears on the same date.

districtFaqs.q: Why does the Cincinnati CPS 2026–27 English calendar differ from the translations?
districtFaqs.a: The English PDF was updated July 16, 2026 with five CFT/CAAS furlough days, 170 student days, and a May 25 last day. The March-created translations still show the earlier 171-day schedule ending May 26.

districtFaqs.q: Is June Summer School part of every CPS student's regular year?
districtFaqs.a: No. The main student year ends in May. The calendar separately identifies Summer School for June 1–30, so families should use the student's program information before treating June as required attendance.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Cincinnati CPS schools use the same event calendar?
districtFaqs.a: The 12-month PDF supplies districtwide dates, but schools and programs may add orientations, testing, performances, athletics, conferences, and other events. Check the student's school calendar as well.

districtFaqs.q: How are Cincinnati neighborhood and magnet school assignments different?
districtFaqs.a: Neighborhood elementary schools are assigned by home address. Magnet programs use the CPS school-selection process, and high schools are not tied to the elementary address assignment in the same way.

customSections.label: How to Read Cincinnati CPS Closure Labels
customSections.content: The official legend is unusually specific about which part of the district closes. For a student calendar, both closure categories mean no classes; the difference is operational.

customSections.label: The District Calendar Does Not Replace School Selection
customSections.content: CPS's citywide calendar and school-assignment system answer different questions. The calendar tells families when districtwide attendance changes; the assignment and selection tools identify the school or program a student may attend.
